values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754115 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754115 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 28ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754115 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a fishing pier/platform (ADA), a toilet, primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp; hand launch on the Clearwater River and a group use area. ADA accessibility rated 'Easy'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754115 (Facilities: 'Fishing Pier/Platform', 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; 'Gravel boat launch on Harpers Lake and hand launch on Clearwater River; group use area and ADA fishing platform.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on Harpers Lake with designated primitive camping: 31 miles east of Bonner on Hwy 200, then north on Hwy 83 for 2 miles. Electric or manual-powered craft only on the lake (no gas engines). --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, the 28-ft trailer limit, the 7-day stay limit (now recorded in booking), fishing platform, toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, limits, FCFS and fees.
